description:
One of the coolest things kiddos do is form bonds - with parents, with family members, and with toys. The Strider Rocking Bike helps your little one bond with their very first bike before they ever take it for a ride.
As soon as your baby begins to crawl, they're ready to explore with the Strider Sport 2-in-1 Rocking Bike and won't stop...at least not until it's nap time. The Strider Sport 2-in-1 Rocking Bike is the best way to teach babies how to balance and improve dexterity, cognitive ability, and spatial awareness. The Rocking Base securely holds the Strider Sport Bike in place as your baby learns how to self-propel and literally rock out. With the Rocking Base attached, this product is intended for ages 6 months - 2 years old. It's a great gift to add to any growing family's baby registry and a fun addition to any nursery!
Our goal is to get kids building skills for riding bikes at the youngest age possible. So, we do extra research and engineering to manufacture products that meet the stringent safety requirements of toys for children age 6+ months. Once your kiddo masters rocking, simply detach the Rocking Base and they're ready to roll into the next step of the Learn-To-Ride process. Learn more with our free Learn to Stride Guide.
From baby steps to big strides, the Strider 12 Sport Balance Bike grows with your kiddo up to 4 years old (inseam measurement of 26-46 cm. / 10-18 in.). With this innovative 2-in-1 design, your rider has everything to learn to ride. No tricycles or training wheels needed.
This is the perfect bike for the littlest riders to build confidence and discover a sense of adventure!
